PhD Student in Bioengineering · UCLA

I study multimodal learning, generative models, and computational
pathology in the Hsu Lab at UCLA. My research explores how machine
learning can integrate medical data and generalize across imaging
domains.

## Research interests

- Multimodal learning for medical data
- Generative models and domain adaptation
- Computational pathology and cancer prognosis
